rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for being independent, including an independent candidate.
Use this for someone who forms and follows their own views instead of being easily influenced.

example.english: My daughter is very independent; she always chooses her own clothes.
example.traditional: 我個女好有主見，買衫一定要自己揀。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 neoi5 hou2 jau5 zyu2 gin3 maai5 saam1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zi6 gei2 gaan2

rows.note: Use this for the unbiased or impartial part of sense 3, especially when judging or making a decision.

example.english: An independent referee must not favor either team.
example.traditional: 做裁判最重要係公正，唔可以偏幫任何一隊。
example.jyutping: zou6 coi4 pun3 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 hai6 gung1 zing3 m4 ho2 ji5 pin1 bong1 jam6 ho4 jat1 deoi6
